identity.method: checked full-formation anchor; fixed dormant identities
identity.note: Same-kit crossings/reacquisition are estimates; missing poses remain absent.

clip.name: nfl_sf_sea
clip.notes: Assisted example: checked calibration, 22-player formation at source 1578, reviewed QB/RB identity corrections, throw/catch approximately 1769/1780 (+/-2 source frames). Ball ground path uses attributed possession/interpolated flight; visible airborne pixel evidence remains separate. Full continuous identity accuracy is not established.

broadcast.source: the broadcaster's own virtual lines, read through the registration; the distance is the officials' spot rounded to a whole yard

ball.method: isolated brown object, camera-compensated sustained flight
ball.flight_projection: ground-plane projection of image sightings; altitude is not recovered
ball.note: A football in a wide broadcast shot is a few pixels and is behind somebody most of the play. Read measured_fraction AND travelled_yards before trusting any possession, passer or throw derived from this: a high detection rate on a static object is a confident wrong answer, and the generic sports-ball class finds broadcast graphics.

reviewed_pass.note: Carrier positions and interpolated airborne ground path are estimates, not ball detections.

registration.note: A homography can fit its own points perfectly and still place the field a hundred yards away. Read render_problems before believing a single coordinate in this file.
